method: Compare actual/background PNGs with only glyph fill transparent, retaining text shadow/material. Minimum background contrast at pixels fitting the expected foreground blend with >=75% glyph coverage and <=12-channel residual; includes alpha/ancestor opacity. Rectangle minima retained separately. Exclude hidden/inert/disabled/collapsed text. Not sitewide certification.
